subject: Proposal: reallocate two runtime seats to kernel performance trial
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: reallocate two runtime seats to kernel performance trial

Team —

I want to propose a short, controlled reallocation: temporarily move two open/runtime-approved SWE slots from the general runtime backlog into a 6-month kernel performance trial team (focused on attention kernels, fused ops and quantization paths). Goal is to validate a ~20% token-cost reduction and 15–25% p50 latency improvement for our most common LLM configurations.

Why now: the kernel work is blocking our ability to ship the new quantized 8-bit path for the Redwood-verified catalog. If we can demonstrate the gains quickly, it unlocks Dedicated cost savings and reduces hosted unit cost.

What I’m asking for:
- Reassign 2 current runtime headcount slots (not headcount increase) for 6 months, starting Nov 9.
- Allow recruiting to hire at upper-band seniority (L6) for one role; request a comp-band exception for that hire (form attached).
- Recruiting to keep one role as a shorter-term contract-to-hire if cost neutrality is preferred.

Impacts to watch: oncall rotation coverage and feature backlog for runtime team. I’ve attached a redistribution sheet that models coverage and net FTE impact across squads. We estimate minimal disruption if we freeze one noncritical project for two quarters.

Next steps: please reply with approval or objections by EOD Friday so recruiting can start outreach. If you want a short review meeting, I can slot 30 minutes Thursday.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HC_Redistribution_Sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: reallocate two runtime seats to kernel performance trial

Sergio —

Thanks for the write-up. A couple questions before I can sign off:

1) Can you quantify the oncall coverage delta (weeks/person) if we remove two engineers? The sheet has high level numbers but I'd prefer explicit rotation math for the next 6 months.
2) If one hire is at L6, what’s the expected comp delta vs hiring two L5s? Need to confirm against the budgeted slot.
3) Contract-to-hire makes sense as a fallback; can we put a 12-week ramp requirement in the plan so we don't lose velocity?

If those are all acceptable I’m inclined to greenlight. Short meeting would help clarify.

—Marcus
VP, Platform

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>

Date: 2026-10-28T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: reallocate two runtime seats to kernel performance trial

+1 on the trial from my side. A few data points to add:
- Our internal perf harness suggests a conservative 12–18% token cost improvement from fused kernels alone; combined with kv-cache improvements we hit 20% in some traces.
- We should prioritize one hire with deep systems/kernel experience; the comp-band exception form is attached (we'll need approval to go to top of band).
- I ran a quick impact sim on pb-side feature delivery; we can delay the async batching rollout by one sprint without customer impact.

Attaching the comp-band-exception-form.pdf for review.

—Mina
Senior Staff SWE, Runtime

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Cc: BlueRidge Talent <recruiter@blueridge-talent.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: reallocate two runtime seats to kernel performance trial — approval in principle

Sergio / Team,

I approve the reallocation in principle. A few conditions before recruiting publishes the JD:
- Provide explicit oncall coverage math (Marcus's point) and a slide for Execs showing the cost-benefit case.
- Recruiting to prepare two JD variants: senior L6 (top-of-band) and contract-to-hire L5, and include both salary ranges in the req.
- Payroll needs notice for any comp-band exceptions; I'll sign the exception if recruiting justifies market tightness.

@BlueRidge — can you draft an outreach plan and candidate profile for a kernel-focused systems SWE? Prefer US-based candidates with strong C/C++ and assembly-level perf experience.

Kimberly Park
VP, People Operations

Attachments: candidate-jd-kernel-L6.docx (draft JD)

From: BlueRidge Talent <recruiter@blueridge-talent.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate pipeline and timing for kernel SWE roles

Hi Sergio / Kimberly,

Thanks for the intro — quick candidate summary for the two role variants you discussed:

1) Senior Kernel SWE (L6 target) — 3 active candidates, all US-based; expected notice periods 4–8 weeks; market comps indicate top-of-band offers will be required for two of the three.
2) Contract-to-hire (L5) — 5 contractors available immediately through our network; able to start 2 weeks after PO; lower cost but lower guarantee of retention.

We attached a short candidate-package-summary.pdf with compensation ranges and expected start windows. Let us know which JD version to open first; we recommend parallel sourcing for both lanes to avoid delays.

Attachments: candidate-package-summary.pdf

Best,
Ayesha Malik
BlueRidge Talent
recruiter@blueridge-talent.com

Date: 2026-10-30T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: reallocate two runtime seats to kernel performance trial — approved

Thanks everyone — based on the feedback I’m moving forward with the following:
- Reallocation approved for 6 months starting Nov 9. Recruiting to open two parallel lanes (L6 top-of-band and contract L5).
- Comp-band exception approved to allow one hire at +10% above current L6 midpoint if BlueRidge validates market comps (Kimberly: you can sign the exception form once BlueRidge uploads the comp packet).
- Marcus: I'll send the explicit oncall coverage math by EOD Monday and a one-slide exec impact summary for your review.
- Hiring ticket: JIRA SUP-1234 — recruiter please reference that in offers.

BlueRidge — please proceed with parallel sourcing and share the first slate by Nov 6.

Sergio
